tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Lead brand color. Headers, primary buttons, large fills and links on cream (5.9:1). Text on green is cream, never ink (ink on green is only 3.2:1).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Warm accent. Highlights, badges and one call-out per view. Text on gold is ink (11.3:1). Not for text on green: use gold-light there (gold on green is only 3.5:1).

tokens.name: gold-light
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a green fill, as the warm alternative to cream (4.6:1). Not for use on cream (1.3:1). Text on gold-light is ink (14.9:1).

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Earthy red for emphasis, errors and warm fills. Reads as text on cream (4.9:1). Text on a clay fill is cream (4.9:1), never ink (3.9:1).

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Page and card background. Also the text color on green (5.9:1) and on clay (4.9:1). Use instead of pure white.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and borders on cream (18.9:1), gold and gold-light.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a green fill.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a gold fill.

tokens.name: on-clay
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a clay fill.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every border and divider, 1px solid, on cream.

styles.name: heading-h4
styles.usage: Section headings and page titles. Anta has one weight, so never set it bold.

styles.name: text-medium
styles.sample: Earthy, grounded and easy to read.
styles.usage: Supporting text under a heading and introductions.

styles.name: text-regular
styles.sample: Body copy, labels and table text.
styles.usage: Default body copy, token names and table cells.

styles.name: text-regular-medium
styles.usage: Emphasis within body copy and short labels.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inner padding of a badge around its swatch.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a tile title and its supporting text, between table rows and inside a badge.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between a tile's text and its media, and between items inside a tile. Gutter on narrow screens.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Bento gutter: the gap between tiles on both axes. Page padding on narrow screens.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Tile padding, on every side.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Gap between a section heading and its grid.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Page padding, the gap between page sections and between separate bento groups.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: The page, full-width bands and tables. Anything that touches the edge of the screen.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Color swatches, chips and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Badges, buttons, small dots and images or screenshots placed inside a tile.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Bento tiles and cards. The largest corner in the system; nothing is a pill or a circle.

tokens.name: border-1
tokens.usage: Every tile, card, input and divider, always in the line color. Filled tiles keep it too.

tokens.name: border-2
tokens.usage: Focus rings (solid line color, offset 2px) and the selected state. Never for decoration.

tokens.name: opacity-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary labels such as token names beside their icon.

layout.note: The bento frame: 12 columns across the content width.

tokens.name: layout-page-width
tokens.usage: Design width of a page.

tokens.name: layout-content-width
tokens.usage: Width of the grid: page width minus space-64 padding on each side.

tokens.name: layout-columns
tokens.usage: Columns in the bento grid; a column is about 87px wide.

tokens.name: layout-gutter
tokens.usage: Gap between tiles, same as space-24.

tokens.name: layout-row
tokens.usage: Height of one grid row. A two-row tile is 376px tall.
